newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says expects pick-up in 1997.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says expects pick-up in 1997.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Friday the government expected the country's economic health to improve in 1997.
"As always, there are different areas of the Australian economy going at different rates. We think, however, that 1997 is going to show a pick-up," Costello told a business luncheon.

Costello said the outlook was underpinned by expected strong international economic growth, the latest cut in official interest rates, an expected increase in domestic disposable income next year, and a pick-up in the housing cycle.
He said disposable income would be boosted by a combination of lower mortgage rates and the government's family tax initiatives due to come into force in January, 1997.
The Reserve Bank reduced official interest rates in July and November, leading to widespread cuts in home lending rates.
